blocker.failure_log_summary: Two initial focused-test invocations failed before crate compilation because /usr/local/bin Homebrew Rust targeted x86_64 while the installed Apple Command Line Tools provide arm64 only. `rustup run` alone left /usr/local/bin/rustc first in PATH. Putting the repository-pinned nightly aarch64 toolchain bin directory first resolved the host mismatch; all 23 contract tests, formatting, and Clippy passed. GitHub Actions run 36525459370: Ubuntu and Windows host jobs passed; nagi-target failed M17 first-web-pixel acceptance (wrapper exit 11; acceptance report exit 1, stage timeout). The guest reached user entry, persistent-storage acceptance, surface acquisition, and GL context creation. During Servo construction, native thread creation was rejected with pthread_error=11 (EAGAIN), Servo profile/mem.rs:48 panicked, QEMU did not exit within 120 seconds, and no pixel checksum/pass marker was emitted. Target diagnostic artifacts are attached to the run. This M17 failure is outside IDENT-01; no M17 source was modified. Production acceptance remains independently blocked by M30/checkpoint and unresolved dependency contracts.
